Glass Sun.name: Glass Sun
Glass Sun.description: The user's signature move: all the light passing through the user's body gathers at once and bursts out of them in a blaze that floods the area. Every enemy facing the user within a street's width takes massive light damage and is blinded until the end of their next turn, while allies warned to look away are spared; afterward the user flickers faintly into view and cannot bend light until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
